import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.workflows.base_processor import BaseProcessor


class DimuonAnalysis(BaseProcessor):
    def object_preselection(self, variation):
        """Build MuonGood collection: pT > 15 GeV, |eta| < 2.4"""
        muons = self.events.Muon
        self.events["MuonGood"] = muons[(muons.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)]
    
    def object_counting(self, variation):
        """Count and store number of selected muons per event"""
        self.events["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(self.events.MuonGood)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    processor = DimuonAnalysis()
